**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

Cài Déjìn's 蔡德晉 (*fl.* 1726–1737) seventeen-juan early-Qīng commentary on the *Yílǐ* ([KR1d0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0025)). The first sixteen juan cover the seventeen *Yílǐ* chapters; the seventeenth juan appends Wú Chéng's [KR1d0034](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0034) eight-chapter *Yílǐ yìjīng* reconstruction with Cài's annotation. The work cites broadly across Sòng-Yuán-Míng commentary tradition cross-referenced with the *zhùshū*. The Sìkù *tíyào* highlights both Cài's lapses (uncritical adoption of Wàn Sīdà's [KR1d0039](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0039) *kuētóu* gloss for the *Shìguānjì* "*kuēfù* of *Bāilǚ*" passage) and his contributions (careful distinction between the hair-securing *jī* (笄) and the cap-securing *jī*, against Áo Jìgōng's [KR1d0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0035) reading). The catalog dates the work to 1726.

**Abstract**

The *Lǐjīng běnyì* is one of the second-tier early-Qīng *Yílǐ* commentaries, less central than the Lǐ-family Ānxī tradition ([KR1d0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0019), [KR1d0020](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0020), [KR1d0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0040)), Zhāng Ěrqí's [KR1d0038](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0038) critical edition, or Fāng Bāo's [KR1d0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0041) *Yílǐ xīyí*, but with substantial individual contributions. Cài Déjìn's incorporation of Wú Chéng's [KR1d0034](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0034) *Yílǐ yìjīng* reconstruction as the seventeenth juan is methodologically significant — it represents an explicit acceptance of the Yuán-period reconstruction project as part of the legitimate working *Yílǐ* corpus.

The Sìkù editors' specific arguments — both the criticism of Cài's adoption of Wàn Sīdà's wood-mould reading of *kuī* and the praise of Cài's two-fold *jī* (hair-pin) reading against Áo Jìgōng — represent the late-Qiánlóng court-classicist methodology of detailed-passage assessment. The dating "1720–1737" brackets the most plausible composition window through Cài Déjìn's recommended-for-Sānlǐ-commission years.
